description: This file contains unit tests for the NATS streaming integration in an Orleans streaming provider. It defines the NatsAdapterTests class which performs setup, teardown, and testing of message sending and receiving through a NATS adapter, utilizing Xunit testing framework.

classes.name: NatsAdapterTests
classes.description: Unit test fixture for NATS streaming adapter integration tests, including setup and cleanup methods, and test case for sending and receiving messages.

methods.name: SendAndReceiveFromNats
methods.description: Test case that initializes the NATS adapter, sends a batch of messages, and verifies message receipt and cache correctness.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Sets up the test environment by connecting to NATS and ensuring the test stream is in a clean state.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Cleans up test resources by deleting the test stream and disposing of the connection.

methods.name: SendAndReceiveFromQueueAdapter
methods.description: Core logic for testing message exchange and cache integrity for the NATS adapter, including message production, consumption, and assertions.

methods.name: CreateEvents
methods.description: Helper method to generate a list of mixed integer and string events for testing.
